{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm no commas in revenue — already clean
print("Are there any commas in the revenue column?")
print(data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any())

# Safe to cast to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Now, check for refunded orders: they should be excluded
print("\nNumber of refunded orders:")
print(data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_data = data[
    (data['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (data['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (data['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_total = filtered_data.shape[0]
n_converted = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total if n_total > 0 else 0

# Output results
print(f"\nFiltered data shape: {filtered_data.shape}")
print(f"Number converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Total: {n_total}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
